name: agentic-team-unlocked
description: Agentic Team — a desktop IDE that orchestrates multiple AI coding agents in parallel across providers.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentic/core && npm run build -w @agentic/server && npm run build -w @agentic/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @agentic/core && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w @agentic/desktop && npm run start -w @agentic/desktop
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run package -w @agentic/desktop
